description: Universidad Veracruzana publishes seven days of measurements from a prototype parabolic-trough solar collector in Coatzacoalcos, Veracruz, Mexico. The named Mendeley Data version-one page lists time, inlet and outlet fluid temperatures, ambient temperature, global and diffuse solar radiation, wind direction and speed, and volume flow rate. Tests occurred in August and September; the repository description does not state the year or the sampling interval. Mendeley lists CC BY 4.0 and public access without charge. A modeller can compare simulated collector heat gain against the observed temperatures and radiation, or use the weather and flow measurements to calibrate a small solar-thermal component. This is one prototype at one site over seven days, not a representative year of utility-scale solar output or district-heating demand. Collector geometry and operating controls may be needed from the article before transferring parameters to another installation. File encoding, measurement quality and the time series itself were not downloaded or checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Experimental results obtained from a parabolic trough collector installed in Coatzacoalcos, Mexico
